FEAT-2-S135.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contract
FEAT-2-S135.description: Define and standardize the input/output schema for specialty identification, including normalized NUCC codes, labels, confidence scores, and aggregation structure, aligned with existing Pydantic tool models.

FEAT-2-S136.title: Expose Specialty Identification via FindCare Facade
FEAT-2-S136.description: Integrate specialty identification into the FindCare facade and tool routing layer, ensuring user queries trigger NUCC mapping and return structured outputs consumable by downstream provider search.

FEAT-2-S137.title: Unit Tests for Specialty Identification Logic
FEAT-2-S137.description: Create unit tests covering regex matching, vector similarity mapping, NUCC deduplication, confidence scoring, and edge cases such as ambiguous or empty inputs.

FEAT-2-S138.title: Integrate Specialty Mapping with Provider Search Pipeline
FEAT-2-S138.description: Wire specialty identification outputs into provider_search_service to ensure NUCC codes are used in taxonomy fallback and filtering logic for provider retrieval.
